description:
# 360-card eternal cube with simple cards and sharp games

## Cube design highlights:
- Preference for cards with less (separate) rules and fewer words
- Interactive games, that require sharp sequencing
- Limit the amount of (unique) tokens
- Limit the amount of (one-off) keywords
- Limit the amount of unnecessary text on cards (e.g. cards mentioning card types that are not in the cube)
‎ 
## Draft guide
Draft for 6 to 8 players
Just the normal 3 packs of 15 cards.  
‎
